C1423.title: Horizen (ZenCash) Suffers 51% Attack with Over $500K in Losses
C1423.summary: In early 2018, the privacy coin Horizen (formerly ZenCash) was hit by a 51% attack. A malicious miner gained control of more than 51% of the blockchain network's computing power and injected fraudulent transactions, resulting in losses exceeding $500,000. The incident prompted the Horizen team to develop a defense mechanism that penalizes malicious miners through a delayed function.
